Subject: AdWords Account Payment Issue

Dear Advertiser,

A recent payment could not be processed.

Your advertisements may be suspended if this issue is not resolved.

To avoid potential disruption to your campaigns, please update your payment information.

Please log in to your account to review and update your payment details.

Thank you for using Google AdWords.
